review: Full-size generated originals and a comparison montage were inspected.

light.evidence: One adult woman, complete head and both feet; slim purple armor and red chest gem, black fitted gloves and five-digit human hands. Large eyes and narrow chin remain distinct from Nosepass, Skitty and Delcatty.

heavy.evidence: Broad overlapping shoulder, forearm, hip, thigh and shin plates enlarge the silhouette without changing her body; face, purple hair and gem locations follow the anchor.

mobility.evidence: Thin shoulder, hip and calf panels sweep outward with gaps and compact red-lit units; the face and long purple hair remain anchored.

light_overdrive.evidence: Pose, feet, camera and hand placement match light; plate seams lift around chest, forearms and hips, exposing violet light and inner parts.

heavy_overdrive.evidence: Same heavy layered silhouette, hands and stance; outer plate edges lift with violet-lit gaps and dark embers, no added weapon or helmet.

mobility_overdrive.evidence: The same swept panels spread farther and expose lit inner mechanisms; both hands, face and camera remain in the closed image positions.

identity.evidence: Same long dark-purple hair, pink eyes, narrow chin and broad asymmetric mouth as the approved light image.

text.evidence: Doorway, mask, gown embroidery and background chandeliers show ornament rather than letters or labels.

hands.evidence: Left side hand holds the mask handle; opposite hand gathers skirt fabric, with natural enclosed fingers and no extra digits.

activity.evidence: She stands at a candlelit event doorway holding a feather mask beside her hip and lifting the full skirt clear of the threshold.

exposure.evidence: Strapless gown leaves shoulders and collarbones bare, and the side slit exposes one leg.

expression.evidence: One mouth corner rises and her lowered lids make a knowing look.

pose.evidence: The forward leg suggests a step, but the upper body is more stationary than a clear mid-stride transfer; recorded without regeneration per IMAGE_RULES 3.6.

orientation.evidence: Torso and pelvis turn together toward the camera at an oblique angle.

framing.evidence: Complete head and both heels fit in the portrait.

outfit.evidence: Garnet structured bodice and full satin skirt dominate the silhouette.

identity.evidence: Purple flowing hair, pink eyes, small tapered chin and face proportions match the anchor.

text.evidence: After targeted correction, the notebook has circular moon and star diagrams without the initial handwriting-like annotations; telescope surfaces have no labels.

hands.evidence: One hand wraps naturally around the focus wheel, the other rests on the sketchbook with separated fingertips.

activity.evidence: Telescope focus adjustment and field-sketch pad are both visible on an outdoor observatory platform.

exposure.evidence: Open vest, cropped white tank and olive shorts leave shoulders, midriff and thighs bare.

expression.evidence: Raised brows, open eyes and a slightly parted mouth convey curiosity.

pose.evidence: Her right-side hand turns the telescope wheel while the other steadies the pad.

orientation.evidence: Camera looks down at the top of her head and angled torso.

framing.evidence: Head to upper thighs and both hand contacts are visible.

outfit.evidence: Vest, tank and shorts are distinct separate workwear pieces.

identity.evidence: Dark-purple hair length and pink eyes remain unchanged; face has the same narrow jaw and small nose.

text.evidence: Paint jars, canvases, clothes and shoes contain paint marks without visible letters or labels.

hands.evidence: One hand holds a palette knife at the tray, the other bends naturally at her chin, without doubled joints or extra fingers.

activity.evidence: Painted canvases, brush jars and tool tray establish the studio, and the palette knife is being returned during cleanup.

exposure.evidence: Tied paint-splattered shirt leaves midriff and collarbones visible; wrap miniskirt exposes legs.

expression.evidence: Brows knit slightly, eyes angle down and the mouth is closed in thought.

pose.evidence: She sits at the workbench edge, elbow supported while leaning toward the tools.

orientation.evidence: Seated hips face diagonally while her upper body twists toward the workbench and camera.

framing.evidence: Complete head and shoes are shown with a substantial studio background; the person occupies more of the frame than environmental framing implies. Recorded without regeneration.

outfit.evidence: Rolled shirt sleeves, tied hem, short wrap skirt and canvas shoes form a different silhouette from the gown and field workwear.

diversity.evidence: Actual recent casual images were compared with the new images. A formal garnet full skirt at an entryway, hands-on telescope workwear from above, and a seated shirt/miniskirt studio cleanup differ in activity, garment shape and body angle from one another and the recent resort, dance, food and festival scenes.
